prompt: Why will the woman mention where the results came from?
promptZh: 女士為什麼要註明結果是在哪裡取得的？
evidence: “We measured the space with the equipment in place.” / “I’ll flag one panel for the bay and a pair for the demonstration.” / “I’ll also note that these results came from the lab.” / “We haven’t measured any of the panels in the bay yet.”

options.text: To distinguish the test results from what has actually been measured on site
options.zh: 區分測試結果與實際現場量測結果。
options.whyZh: 結果是在實驗室取得，維修區還沒實測任何面板；標註來源是為了避免把兩者當成同一件事。

options.text: To explain why two panels must be put together in the maintenance bay
options.zh: 解釋為什麼維修區必須把兩塊面板合在一起用。
options.whyZh: 實際維修區只需選一塊面板，兩塊一組是示範用途。

options.text: To say that the chart should not be used to compare any of the panels
options.zh: 表示不應用圖表比較任何面板。
options.whyZh: 女士明確要根據圖表標示適合的面板，沒有拒絕用圖表比較。

options.text: To show that the panel depth limit was set in the lab
options.zh: 證明面板厚度上限是在實驗室訂的。
options.whyZh: 厚度限制是在設備就位時量得的維修區空間，不是實驗室設定的上限。

explanationZh: 結果是在實驗室取得，維修區還沒實測任何面板；標註來源是為了避免把兩者當成同一件事。
